benchmarks.name: Talabat Mart
paragraphs: Talabat combines practical convenience messaging with promotions, fast delivery and a broad choice of shopping occasions. Its Egyptian website advertises groceries, food, flowers and medicine, while Talabat Mart highlights 15-minute delivery.

Strong brand familiarity, cross-category reach, substantial logistics infrastructure and an established delivery ecosystem. Its April 2026 distribution hub covers approximately 27,000 m2 and supports its Mart network across 12 Egyptian cities.
Content has a lot of big collaborations, social shows as sponsors, rather than just only a supermarket.

What Breadfast can learn: Communicate convenience without making speed the entire story. Breadfast should connect its services to specific Egyptian needs and occasions while demonstrating its own product and brand advantages.

benchmarks.name: Rabbit
paragraphs: A fast, reliable shopping solution built around frequently needed groceries and household essentials.
Its campaigns used newspaper-inspired layouts, large typography and recognizable lime-green branding to present a practical subscription benefit in an attention-grabbing way.

Clear service proposition, distinctive brand identity and emphasis on practical customer benefits. Rabbit's app reports more than 1.4 million customers, 40 million items delivered and approximately 15-minute average delivery. These are company-reported figures.
What Breadfast can learn: Give audiences additional emotional and lifestyle reasons to choose Breadfast.

benchmarks.name: Instashop
paragraphs: A convenient digital marketplace connecting customers with supermarkets and other retailers.

The central commercial proposition is access to stores, product variety and the convenience of ordering through one platform. This is a positioning-level assessment, not a measured analysis of its recent Instagram content.
Content is heavily reliant on influencers collaborations, other than that the content is very still.
Marketplace variety, familiar retail partners and a proposition that lets customers shop from multiple stores.

What Breadfast can learn: Product availability alone is not enough for distinctive brand communication. Breadfast can potentially differentiate through original product storytelling, own-brand products, consistent content experiences and connected category discovery.

benchmarks.name: Noon Minutes
paragraphs: Ultra-fast access to groceries, everyday essentials, personal care and other products through noon's commerce ecosystem.Its Egyptian launch focused on speed, product selection, value and Prime membership benefits.
Unlike competitors that focus primarily on groceries, noon Minutes combines quick-commerce convenience with the resources of a larger digital retail platform.
launched a big campaign lately with huge outdoors and copies and influencers collabs.

What Breadfast can learn: Turn Convenience into an Experience: Go beyond speed and promotions by creating memorable, culturally relevant content and activations that drive engagement and product discovery.

accounts.name: Supermarket
accounts.direction:
Our content will revolve around the reality of Egyptian households: the never-ending grocery lists, forgotten essentials, unexpected guests, family food preferences, and the daily challenge of managing household needs.
We’ll combine relatable Egyptian humor, practical shopping solutions, product storytelling, and real consumer experiences to make supermarket content both entertaining and commercially relevant.
CONTENT DIRECTION

## 01. EVERYDAY MADE EASY | Product & Price — 30%
- Animated Price-Hero Reels: Fast-paced product animations highlighting offers, prices, and everyday essentials through bold typography and dynamic transitions.
- Curated Basket Carousels: Swipeable product collections organized around specific budgets, household sizes, or shopping occasions, with a complete basket revealed on the final slide.
- Product Spotlight Statics: Clean, product-first visuals introducing new arrivals, exclusive brands, and frequently purchased essentials.

## 02. EVERYDAY, THE BREADFAST WAY| CULTURE & TRENDS — 25%
- Trending Audio Reels: Adapt relevant Egyptian TikTok sounds and memes to familiar supermarket situations.
- Meme-Style Statics: Simple, humorous visuals built around recognizable shopping behaviors.

## 03. LITTLE LIFE HACKS | Usefulness — 20%
- Recipe Reels: Quick overhead cooking videos demonstrating simple meals made with Breadfast ingredients.
- Step-by-Step Carousels: Save-worthy guides covering meal preparation, shopping organization, and ingredient substitutions.

### CONTENT DIRECTION

## 04. REAL LIFE, REAL PEOPLE | Community &

### Creators — 15%
- Street Interview Reels: Asking Egyptian consumers about their shopping habits, essential products, and household preferences.
- Creator-Led Basket Videos: Lifestyle and food creators sharing what they regularly order.
- Shopping Challenges: Interactive videos where participants build baskets within a specific budget or for a particular occasion.

## 05. BETTER TOGETHER | Brand & Campaigns — 10%
- Lifestyle Reels: Showcasing complete occasions that combine Supermarket with Food, Coffee, or other relevant verticals.
- Collaborative Carousels: Product combinations involving multiple Breadfast categories.

###

Shift from products to people (in regular content anc series not just copes)

accounts.name: Coffee
accounts.direction:
We want to build a recognizable coffee culture around moods, routines, personalities, conversations, and small daily pleasures.
The content should be warm, visually appealing, and relatable, while giving people reasons to discover new drinks and return to their favorites.

### CONTENT DIRECTION

#### 01. EVERYDAY MADE EASY | Product & Price — 30%
- Coffee ASMR Reels
- Product Hero Videos: Cinematic drink reveals featuring menu favorites, new flavors, and seasonal launches.
- Menu Carousels: Visual drink guides highlighting different options and flavor profiles.

#### 02. EVERYDAY, THE BREADFAST WAY | CULTURE & TRENDS — 25%
- Relatable coffee situations inspired by office workers, students, and everyday routines.
- Trending Audio Videos: Coffee-related interpretations of popular social trends.
- Coffee Personality Posts: Entertaining content matching drinks with moods and personalities.

#### 03. LITTLE LIFE HACKS | Usefulness — 20%
- Behind-the-Bar Videos: Showing how different drinks are prepared.
- Educational Carousels: Simple visual guides helping audiences understand the menu. CONTENT DIRECTION

#### 04. REAL LIFE, REAL PEOPLE | Community & Creators — 15%
- Conversation Reels: Casual interviews with creators and customers over Breadfast coffee.
- Barista-Led Videos: Featuring preparation techniques, personal recommendations, and behind-the-scenes moments.

#### 05. BETTER TOGETHER | Brand & Campaigns — 10%
- Food Pairing posts: Visually appealing combinations of Breadfast Coffee with Food or Supermarket products.
- Lifestyle Videos: Coffee as part of a connected workday, study session, or weekend routine.

Creator-led content (Karim Gabriel) and events and collaborations make the account more human and community-led.
Its earlier Coffee Simplified series used baristas to educate consumers about brewing coffee at home. The brand has also explored experiential marketing through The List, an event concept connecting coffee, music and community.

Reintroduce or evolve barista-led education and establish weekly drink-focused series
Introduce Coffee × Food pairings, breakfast occasions and relevant Supermarket products

accounts.name: Beauty
accounts.direction:
Breadfast Beauty should feel like the friend who knows the products, understands the trends, and helps you make better beauty decisions.
Rather than treating the page as an online product catalog, we’ll create an engaging beauty destination where audiences can discover products, learn new techniques, explore routines, and hear authentic opinions.

### CONTENT DIRECTION

#### 01. EVERYDAY MADE EASY | Product & Price — 30%
- Editorial Product Reels: Premium close-ups showcasing beauty products, packaging, textures, and benefits.
- Product Discovery Carousels: Curated beauty collections grouped by routines, occasions, or needs.
- Routine-Based Reels: Showing products being used as part of morning, evening, or getting-ready routines.
- Launch Statics: Visually engaging product-first posts announcing new arrivals and exclusive drops.

#### 02. EVERYDAY, THE Breadfast WAY | Culture & Trends — 25%
- GRWM Reels: Creator-led getting-ready videos featuring relatable Egyptian lifestyle situations.
- Trending Beauty Reels: Recreating relevant makeup and skincare trends using products available on Breadfast.

#### 03. LITTLE LIFE HACKS | Usefulness — 20%
Tutorial Reels: Step-by-step makeup application and skincare demonstrations.
Educational Carousels: Simplifying product ingredients, beauty routines, and application techniques.
Expert-Led Content: Makeup artists and qualified skincare professionals explaining suitable product uses.

### CONTENT DIRECTION

### 04. REAL LIFE, REAL PEOPLE | Community & Creators — 15%
- Creator Reviews: Honest first impressions and product experiences.
- Real Routine Videos: Creators and customers showing how products fit into their actual
routines.
- Beauty Q&A Reels: Answering audience-submitted questions with relevant demonstrations.

### 05. BETTER TOGETHER | Brand & Campaigns — 10%
- Lifestyle Editorial Reels: Self-care occasions connecting Beauty with Coffee, Food, and Supermarket.
- Cross-Vertical Carousels: Curated lifestyle recommendations involving multiple categories.

### CONTENT SERIES

#### 1- Personas Narration
A relatable, character-driven series featuring different beauty personalities, each with their own habits, struggles, and routines. Through humorous storytelling and everyday situations, we showcase how Breadfast Beauty fits into different lifestyles, making self-care easier and more enjoyable.

#### 2- Understand your skin’s language
An educational series that helps audiences understand their skin's needs through simple, engaging explanations. From identifying skin types and understanding ingredients to recognizing common skin concerns, the series offers practical beauty knowledge and relevant product recommendations to help consumers make more informed choices.

accounts.direction:
Breadfast Food’s content should make people hungry before they even realize they’re hungry.
We’ll combine appetizing food visuals, entertaining Egyptian food culture and real taste experiences to build stronger interest in the menu.

### CONTENT DIRECTION

- Food Porn Reels: Highly appetizing close-ups emphasizing textures, sauces, steam, and food preparation.
- Product Statics: Strong food photography highlighting key menu items and approved offers.
- Meal Combination Carousels: Visually presenting different menu options for relevant occasions.

#### 02. EVERYDAY, THE Breadfast WAY | Culture & Trends — 25%
- Trending Food Videos: Adapt popular food challenges and trends to Breadfast’s menu.
- Meme Statics: Relatable humor about hunger, sharing food, and choosing what to eat.

#### 03. LITTLE LIFE HACKS | Usefulness — 20%
- Menu Guide Carousels: Helping audiences explore menu categories and dish options.
- Recommendation Reels: Presenting meals based on appetite, mood, or occasion. CONTENT DIRECTION

## 04. REAL LIFE, REAL PEOPLE | Community & Creators — 15%
- Taste-Test Reels: Authentic customer and creator reactions to different menu items.
- Interactive Challenges: Participants choosing, ranking, or comparing dishes.

## 05. BETTER TOGETHER | Brand & Campaigns — 10%
- Collaborative Product Videos: Showing complementary items from different verticals.
- Cross-Account Carousels: Connected meal and snack recommendations.

### CONTENT SERIES

#### 1- Food Red Flags
A playful series exposing the controversial food habits that divide Egyptians, encouraging audiences to debate in the comments.
Sample Content: "Food Red Flags We Need to Talk About" — the friend who steals fries, the person who removes all the pickles, or someone who says they're not hungry and then eats half your order.

accounts.name: Pay
accounts.direction:
Breadfast Pay should be the most straightforward and reassuring page of the five.
Our focus is to remove confusion, explain benefits clearly, and make payment-related features more approachable, particularly for consumers who are unfamiliar with them.
The page can still be relatable and occasionally humorous, but clarity and accuracy must always come first.

### CONTENT DIRECTION

#### 01. EVERYDAY MADE EASY | Product & Price — 30%
- Feature Explainer Reels: Short videos introducing available payment features and their practical benefits.
- Motion Graphic Posts: Simple animations communicating verified rewards, features, and approved offers.
- Feature Launch Carousels: Clear visual introductions to new payment functionalities.

#### 02. EVERYDAY, THE Breadfast WAY | Culture & Trends — 25%
- Generational Comparison Videos: Different age groups reacting to digital payment habits.
- Meme-Style Posts: Simple, culturally relevant observations about everyday transactions.

#### 03. LITTLE LIFE HACKS | Usefulness — 20%
- Step-by-Step Tutorials: Short screen-recording videos explaining how to use specific features.
- FAQ Carousels: Visual answers to common payment-related questions.
- 15-Second Explainers: One feature or benefit explained clearly in each video.
- Educational Motion Graphics: Breaking down relevant processes into simple steps. CONTENT DIRECTION

#### 04. REAL LIFE, REAL PEOPLE | Community & Creators — 15%
- Creator-Led Explainers: Trusted lifestyle or financial creators simplifying relevant features.
- Customer Q&A Reels: Answering frequently asked questions through practical scenarios.?
- Lifestyle Demonstrations: Showing different consumer profiles, including older audiences, learning about available payment options.

#### 05. BETTER TOGETHER | Brand & Campaigns — 10%
- Cross-Vertical Demonstration Reels: Showing how Pay can be used within eligible shopping experiences.
- Collaborative Carousels: Explaining applicable payment benefits alongside other Breadfast categories.
- Connected Lifestyle Stories: Pay appearing naturally in broader Breadfast customer journeys.
- Campaign Motion Graphics: Communicating approved Pay participation in master-brand campaigns.

#

The biggest communication challenge is making these financial services easy to understand, trustworthy, and relevant to everyday Egyptian consumers.

Introduce weekly educational and practical content series

about:
ABOUT BREADFAST
Breadfast has evolved from a grocery delivery service into a multi-category quick-commerce platform spanning Supermarket, Beauty, Coffee, Food, and Pay. As competition in Egypt's digital market grows, Breadfast faces the challenge of strengthening awareness of its expanding services while maintaining one cohesive brand identity. The opportunity lies in moving beyond product-led communication to become a more relevant and engaging part of consumers' everyday lives.

#
implications:
STRATEGIC
IMPLICATIONSKeytakeaways
Beauty deserves discovery-led, creator-led storytelling, rather than being presented as another supermarket category.
Consumers have a growing set of online-shopping alternatives. Breadfast needs reasons to be chosen repeatedly, beyond app availability.
Value needs to be demonstrated clearly: useful baskets, price comparisons, bundles and cost-conscious routines.
Pay has an opportunity to make digital transactions feel familiar, useful, rewarding and trustworthy.
Social content is a major discovery opportunity, but publishing volume alone won't translate into orders.

#
personaTakeaways:
# KEY TAKEAWAYS Personas Analysis
One Consumer, Multiple Needs Convenience Is the Common Ground Value Goes Beyond Price
Different Audiences Require Different Communication Everyday Moments Drive Relevance Trust Encourages Trial
Discovery Is the Gateway to Cross-Vertical Growth
## DIFFERENT LIFESTYLES. SHARED EVERYDAY NEEDS. ONE CONNECTED ECOSYSTEM. Breadfast's opportunity lies in understanding the moments that connect its diverse audiences and transforming individual category awareness into broader everyday relevance. By delivering personalized, relatable, and useful content, Breadfast can encourage discovery, strengthen consideration, and build lasting customer relationships.

pillars:
CONTENT PILLARS
1-Everyday Made Easy
This is our most commercially driven pillar.
Instead of simply showcasing products, we’ll communicate their value through relevant situations, useful combinations, and recognizable consumer needs.
2-EVERYDAY, THE Breadfast WAY
This pillar focuses on the situations, habits, conversations, and humor that make everyday Egyptian life recognizable.
We’ll use trends as creative opportunities rather than simply following them.
3- LITTLE LIFE HACKS
3-Little Life Hacks
This pillar gives consumers a reason to save and return to Breadfast’s content, even when they’re not immediately planning to purchase. CONTENT PILLARS
4- REAL LIFE, REAL PEOPLE
Strengthen trust, authenticity, and emotional connection through real consumer experiences and creator-led storytelling.
Rather than having Breadfast do all the talking, this pillar gives consumers and creators a voice.
5- BETTER TOGETHER
This is the pillar that brings the five pages together.
Rather than forcing all accounts to publish identical content, we’ll connect them through shared moments, relevant occasions, and complementary needs.
